lines: Fine. I'll lower my guard, but I am keeping the straps tight.
Fine. I'll set this down before it gets heavier.
Fine. I can step back, but do not make me regret it.
Fine. I can let this cool, but do not mistake calm for forgetting.
That helps. Keep your hands peaceful and we may still end this properly.
Not enough. If you want peace, bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds} and mean it.
You are short. A nervous apology does not settle a public mistake.
No. I am too angry to bargain while you are standing there like that.
Put the weapon away first. I will not discuss peace with steel in my face.
This can still end quietly. Do not make me <shake>regret</shake> offering that chance.
Keep your distance and we have peace.
That will not cover the dent you put in my patience. It takes {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
That's short of the full repair. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Not enough. It takes {emerald_cost} {emeralds} to settle this.
I will not settle for less.
No. Armor is for people I mean to protect, and that is not you right now.
No. Some damage has to cool before payment matters.
No. Keep {payment_items}. Trust is not ready to trade.
